text:
Ethan: user reports no free-trial credits after signup + email verify. they did the magic-link verify, added card, saw a successful charge authorization but credits never applied.
Nina: can you paste the user id and timestamps? I can check the grant logs.
Ethan: user id u_8f3b2a, signup 2024-11-05T13:22:10Z, email verify 2024-11-05T13:24:00Z, payment-method add 13:24:30Z, stripe auth OK (auth id pi_1Kxxxx).
Samir: quick look: the autogrant pipeline expects email_verified=true before payment_webhook processed. webhooks came in first for this account due to network retry ordering, so autogrant never transitioned. there's also an extra gate: domain_classification flagged the email as "org-like" because it's a forwarding alias (user@forwarder.example). that toggles business gating which requires phone_otp.
PaymentsOps: logs from billing-service: `grant_trial(u_8f3b2a)` -> returned 409: "gate:business_email_requires_phone_otp" at 2024-11-05T13:24:40Z. then at 13:24:42 webhook re-ran and email_verified=true but the grant path is idempotent and our retry window expired.
Ethan: ugh. user DID get the magic link & clicked, but forwarding domain normalized to company domain so it counted as business. they didn't get prompted for phone OTP.
Nina: do we have evidence the UI prompted phone_otp and user skipped? or was the gate only applied server-side?
Samir: server-side only. domain_classification runs in signup flow asynchronously; race: webhook -> payment auth -> billing-service checks domain_class but sees null, then later domain classifier marks as org and updates user.flag business_email=true. billing-service doesn't auto-retry grants on new flags.
SupportBot: Automated check: found 1 matching case in manual-grants queue: ticket MG-2024-1157 created.
Ethan: I manually issued the grant via PaymentsOps console: `POST /internal/manual_grant` payload `{ "user_id": "u_8f3b2a", "reason": "support_manual_grant_race" }` and it returned 200. user confirmed credits appeared.
PaymentsOps: repro steps for eng: 1) create account with forwarding alias domain 2) simulate stripe webhook arriving before email-verify callback 3) run domain classifier async 4) verify grant not applied automatically.
Samir: proposed fixes: - Have billing-service listen for email_verified and domain_classification change events and re-evaluate grant eligibility (idempotent safe). - Extend webhook retry window and/or store pending grants for 2 minutes. - Mark forwarding/alias domains as consumer by default until phone_otp explicitly set.
Nina: prioritize as P2? affects only small subset (alias/domains + webhook ordering) but causes manual ops. I can add to the backlog and assign to eng-payments.
Ethan: logged bug: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3242 (assigned to Samir). Included logs and the curl snippet I used.
Samir: adding unit tests for the event re-eval path. I'll also add a metric `manual_grants_per_race` and alert if >5/day.
Nina: thanks. I'll follow up with the affected user to confirm resolution and offer promo extension if needed. :thumbsup:
Ethan: thanks all. leaving the manual-grant ticket open until INF-3242 merged.
SupportBot: Note: thread auto-closed after no activity for 48h."
